description:
Verify derived dense operations inherit optimized primitives.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] invert/solve/determinant rows meet the 1.5x threshold or have approved follow-up scope, scoped per-cell by the maturity markers below.
- [hard] Correctness tests cover singular and rank-deficient inputs.

## Amendment - 2026-05-07 (user-approved, Path A)

Per AskUserQuestion 2026-05-07 (7e41400f closure), criterion #1 is amended to permit per-cell maturity-marker scoping. Empirical basis is the e7e41400f evidence doc (`dev/bench_results/2026-05-07-7e41400f-invert-solve-det.md`).

Per-cell maturity markers (13 cells total: 3 ops x 3 sizes x ~ 2 regimes, with rank-deficient invert returning None and contributing one verdict per size):

- **solve at all (n, regime): [hard] PASS** -- 0.24x-0.60x of fflas. Direct Criterion measurements; inherits PLE/TRSM tuning wins.
- **det at all (n, regime): [hard] PASS** -- approximately equal to PLE time; beats fflas pluq by 1.8x.
- **invert/deficient at all sizes: [hard] PASS** -- invert returns None after PLE detects rank deficiency; ~0.18x-0.34x of fflas.
- **invert/uniform/n=64: [hard] PASS** -- 0.67x of fflas (just inside threshold).
- **invert/uniform/n=256: [aspirational]** -- 1.79x of fflas. Algorithm-choice gap: gf2-core uses Dumas-Pernet Table 2 driver (PLE + 2 trtri + full n^3 GEMM); fflas-ffpack uses in-place dgetrf/dgetri that reuses the LU factorization without the full GEMM. The constituent primitives are tuned (PLE alone is 0.55x of fflas pluq), but the algorithm choice multiplies algorithmic work by ~4x.
- **invert/uniform/n=1024: [aspirational]** -- 1.98x of fflas. Same algorithm-choice cause as n=256. The gap widens with n because the full n^3 GEMM dominates.

The 2 invert/uniform [aspirational] cells are owned by the in-place LU-reuse follow-up issue **`d1a5fea8`** (Replace Dumas-Pernet inv() driver with in-place LU-reuse), filed 2026-05-07 as a sibling under story `72ab6d0e`. d1a5fea8 depends on 7e41400f closing.

Re-escalation threshold: re-escalate to user when `d1a5fea8` closes (revisit invert/uniform cells with fresh measurements).
